decisions.reason: The accelerator program costs little to run and is still visibly promoted on the home page, which ties the firm's reputation to it, but it sits furthest from the core machinery business and the firm has already shown in 2024 that it will drop products, so withdrawal is a close call.

The mobile SNOWFLAKE plant is a recent, heavily invested addition to the modular WASTX line and central to the announced decentralized-recycling strategy, so management will keep it and attribute any slow uptake to market ramp-up.
